WHATSAPP_INTENT.validOperation: The real WhatsApp boundaries preserve pending state and domain effects across invalid replies, cancellation, confirmation, duplicate delivery and tenant isolation without unnecessary provider calls.

QUESTION.validOperation: The real slash-question capability returns a bounded answer and truthfully reports whether web search executed.

NUTRITION_SEARCH.validOperation: The real nutrition search boundary accepts only a compatible product with verifiable provider-linked evidence and rejects ambiguity.

EMBEDDING.validOperation: The real embedding boundary returns a compatible catalog match or degrades safely to no semantic result.

TRANSCRIPTION.validOperation: The real transcription boundary returns useful PT-BR text and applies bounded retry/fallback policy.

IMAGE_ANNOTATION.validOperation: The real annotation boundary applies local, external or off mode while preserving the original and safe degradation.

FOOD_CLASSIFICATION.validOperation: NOVA classification is returned inside the real meal structured output with exactly one provider call.
